feeds.title: Homes of the Rich
feeds.description: Homes of the Rich is the #1 luxury real estate blog on the web. We post all the latest million dollar homes & mansions to hit the market from all over the world. Since 2008 over 12 million 'luxury real estate obsessed' people have visited the site.

feeds.title: Tarrywile
feeds.description: The Tarrywile Park Authority's mission is to provide a sustained balance of passive recreation, environmental education, and historic preservation. Tarrywile Park & Mansion offers something for everyone. Whether you are looking for a venue for an event or a place to get back to nature, come explore and learn more about this great place! Read our blog, keep up with what's new at Tarrywile.

feeds.title: Schuyler Mansion State Historic Site
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of Schuyler Mansion State Historic Site! This blog contains articles written by the staff at Schuyler Mansion about the historic property and its residents.

feeds.title: Mansion Farm Inn | Your Coastal Countryside Escape
feeds.description: Our historic Mansion Farm Inn Bed and Breakfast in Milton, Delaware, lies just a few miles north of the Delawares eastern shore beaches. Read our Blog to find out what is happening at Mansion Farm Inn, and to stay updated on news and events in the Lewes, Delaware area.

feeds.title: Victoria Mansion | A National Historic Landmark
feeds.description: Victoria Mansion is a much-loved Portland landmark but its significance extends far beyond Maine. Distinguished for its architecture and its extraordinary original interiors, it is among the most important historic homes of the nineteenth century anywhere in the nation. Our mission is to conserve, maintain, and restore the Victoria Mansion property and collections to the highest standards, and to interpret them in their social and historical context to a local, state, and national audience. Read more on this blog.

feeds.title: Beckenham Place Mansion
feeds.description: For the first time in decades, this beautiful Georgian mansion is open daily to the public as an arts, cultural and community center. The Mansion is a Grade II* Georgian building, meaning it is of architectural and historical significance. At the Mansion, we connect with lots of different visitors, organizations, and practitioners who use the space in different ways. Our blog will focus on some of these stories.

feeds.title: Cameo Heights | Our Walla Walla Blog
feeds.description: On the majestic basalt bluffs which overlook the peaceful Walla Walla River, Cameo Heights Mansion rises over a lush 400-acre orchard and vineyard. This unique location, removed from the din of city noise and lights, creates an oasis of serenity and scenic beauty in the midst of Washington wine country. Know more about us, on this blog.

feeds.title: Vrooman Mansion
feeds.description: Find joy in every stay at Vrooman Mansion, a historic Bed & Breakfast located near Bloomington/Normal in Central Illinois. Read Our Blog to stay in touch, learn about upcoming Vrooman Mansion events, and to keep up-to-date on what's happening in the central Illinois area.

feeds.title: The Sayre Mansion | Bethlehem's urban haven
feeds.description: There are many hotels in Bethlehem PA, but few match the charm of Sayre Mansion. Located in the heart of Bethlehem, it is a meticulously restored Lehigh Valley inn. Our award-winning Bethlehem PA bed and breakfast is perfect for a Lehigh Valley getaway. Check out the latest happenings in Lehigh Valley, brought to you by Sayre Mansion!

feeds.title: Oaklands Mansion
feeds.description: Oaklands Mansion- Nationally registered historic landmark reflects prosperity in the Old South, as well as hardships suffered during the Civil War. Stay up to date on news and happenings at Oaklands Historic House Museum in Murfreesboro, TN.

feeds.title: Belmont Mansion
feeds.description: Belmont Mansion is the largest house museum in Tennessee and one of a few whose history revolves around the life of a woman: Adelicia Acklen. In this blog, you will find insights into the history and preservation of Belmont Mansion.

feeds.title: Reynolds Mansion
feeds.description: An Architectural delight, the Mansion is an 1885 brownstone built by Bellefonte's first millionaire. A boutique hotel in Bellefonte, PA, nine miles from State College and Penn State. Reynolds Mansion B&B is a unique bed and breakfast with luxurious rooms.

feeds.title: The Fleur-De-Lys-Mansion
feeds.description: Welcome to The Fleur-De-Lys Mansion in St. Louis, MO! This beautiful home was built in 1913 by Mr. and Mrs. William E. Beckman. Make the Fleur-de-Lys Mansion your bed and breakfast destination in the historic Compton Heights neighborhood near Missouri's St. Louis University. Find out what is going on around St. Louis and with The Fleur-De-Lys.

feeds.title: Honor Mansion
feeds.description: Honor Mansion is a romantic Healdsburg hotel located in Northern CA. Our Sonoma County hotel & resort provides the ultimate luxury vacation in wine country. Follow this blog to know more about us.
